run_unsupervised_training: run unsupervised adversarial training for cross-lingual word embeddings between source and target languages
run_procrustes_refinement: run iterative Procrustes refinement to improve cross-lingual embedding alignment using generated dictionaries
build_model: build a model with source embeddings, target embeddings, mapping, and discriminator from parameters
run_trainer_dis_step: run a discriminator training step to classify source vs target embeddings during adversarial training
run_trainer_mapping_step: run a mapping training step to fool the discriminator and align cross-lingual embeddings
